message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that should keep you on the edge of your seat:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread, with iconic imagery and Jack Nicholson’s unforgettable performance. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotional trauma. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | A smart, socially conscious horror that mixes satire with genuine scares. |
| 4 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A well‑crafted paranormal thriller that sparked a whole franchise. |
| 5 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Suspense built around silence; a fresh take on the survival horror genre. |
| 6 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight horror that turns a folk festival into a nightmare. |
| 7 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | A modern folk‑tale with a relentless, creeping threat. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | Psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood. |
| 9 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | A slow‑burning, atmospheric period horror that feels like a living nightmare. |
|10 | **Suspiria (2018)** | 2018 | Luca Guadagnino | A visually stunning remake that amps up the supernatural terror. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | A modern retelling of a Japanese horror classic, with a creepy videotape that haunts. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Oren Peli | Low‑budget found‑footage horror that still manages to terrify. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Drew Goddard | A meta‑take on horror tropes that delivers both laughs and chills. |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | Alejandro Amenábar | A gothic thriller with a twist that keeps you guessing. |
|15 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | William Friedkin | The quintessential exorcism film that set the standard for supernatural horror. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a psychological thriller, a supernatural scare, or something that blends horror with social commentary. Enjoy the fright!
